## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
```

# 1. Sample meta

## 1.1 Inspect

```{r}
meta_raw
```

```{r}
meta_raw |>
  glimpse()
```

## 1.2 Remove redundant columns

`Sample_ID` is an exact copy of `SampleID`, so we check that before dropping it. `Sample` is the trailing number of the ID. `Month` and `Range_Age` can be derived from `Date` and `Age`, so we recompute them in `03_augment.qmd` instead of trusting the typed-in versions.

```{r}
meta_raw |>
  summarise(sample_id_identical = all(SampleID == Sample_ID))

meta_clean <- meta_raw |>
  select(-Sample_ID, -Sample, -Month, -Range_Age)
```

## 1.3 Rename columns to snake_case

The cytokine column names contain dots and Greek letters (`IFN.γ_normalized`), which are awkward to type, so we give them short names.

```{r}
meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  rename(sample_id = SampleID,
         il2 = starts_with("IL.2"),
         ifn_g = starts_with("IFN"),
         tnf_a = starts_with("TNF"),
         il1ra = starts_with("IL.1Ra")) |>
  rename_with(.fn = str_to_lower)
```

## 1.4 Fix column types

```{r}
meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  mutate(date = dmy(date),
         age = as.integer(age),
         across(.cols = c(il2, ifn_g, tnf_a, il1ra),
                .fns = as.numeric))
```

## 1.5 Fix broken text encoding

Some municipality names lost their accents (`√É¬ëu√É¬±oa` should be Ñuñoa), and one internal code contains invisible characters (`VND 619`).

```{r}
meta_clean |>
  filter(str_detect(city, "[^[:alpha:] ]")) |>
  distinct(city)

meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  mutate(city = case_when(str_detect(city, "^San Ram") ~ "San Ramón",
                          str_detect(city, "^Maip") ~ "Maipú",
                          str_detect(city, "oa$") &
                            str_detect(city, "[^[:alpha:] ]") ~ "Ñuñoa",
                          .default = city),
         internal_code = str_remove_all(internal_code, "[^A-Z0-9_]"))
```

## 1.6 Categorical variables as factors

```{r}
meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex),
         result = factor(result, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
         variant = factor(variant,
                          levels = c("Negative", "Gamma", "Lambda", "Delta")))
```

## 1.7 Quality checks

**Inconsistent sample:** `Result` and `Variant` should agree. One sample is `Negative` but labelled `Delta`. We flag it and exclude it from the analyses, because we cannot tell which of the two labels is wrong.

```{r}
meta_clean |>
  count(result, variant)

meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  mutate(qc_label_mismatch = (result == "Negative") != (variant == "Negative"))

meta_clean |>
  filter(qc_label_mismatch)
```

**Duplicated cytokine profiles:** different samples should not have exactly the same four cytokine values. Their microbiota profiles differ, so these are not duplicated samples. This looks like a copy-paste error in the cytokine sheet, so we flag these samples.

```{r}
meta_clean <- meta_clean |>
  group_by(il2, ifn_g, tnf_a, il1ra)  |>
  mutate(qc_cytokine_duplicated = n() > 1) |>
  ungroup()

meta_clean |>
  filter(qc_cytokine_duplicated) |>
  arrange(tnf_a) |>
  select(sample_id, variant, date, il2, ifn_g, tnf_a, il1ra)
```

**Missing values:**

```{r}
meta_clean |>
  summarise(across(.cols = everything(), .fns = ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_na") |>
  filter(n_na > 0)
```

# 2. Taxonomy table

## 2.1 Inspect

```{r}
tax_raw
```

```{r}
tax_raw |>
  glimpse()
```

## 2.2 Swap the mislabelled columns

The column named `Order` contains classes (e.g. Gammaproteobacteria) and `Class` contains orders (e.g. Pseudomonadales), so the two headers are swapped.

```{r}
tax_raw |>
  distinct(Order, Class) |>
  head()

tax_clean <- tax_raw |>
  rename(class = Order,
         order = Class) |>
  rename_with(.fn = str_to_lower)
```

## 2.3 Clean identifiers and names

-   The ASV IDs contain a space (`seq 001`), which is replaced by `_`.
-   SILVA adds numeric suffixes to some genera (`Corynebacterium_1`, `Prevotella_7`), which are removed so that all ASVs of a genus group together.
-   The species column repeats the genus (`Prevotella_7 melaninogenica`), so only the species epithet is kept.

```{r}
tax_clean <- tax_clean |>
  mutate(asv_id = str_replace(id, " ", "_"),
         genus = str_remove(genus, "_\\d+$"),
         species = str_remove(species, "^\\S+\\s")) |>
  select(asv_id, kingdom:species)

tax_clean |>
  count(kingdom)
```

# 3. ASV count table

## 3.1 Inspect

```{r}
asv_raw
```

The table is wide: one row per ASV and one column per sample.

```{r}
dim(asv_raw)
asv_raw[1:5, 1:5]
```

## 3.2 Pivot to long format

```{r}
asv_clean <- asv_raw |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "reads") |>
  mutate(asv_id = str_replace(ID, " ", "_"),
         reads = as.integer(reads)) |>
  select(sample_id, asv_id, reads)

asv_clean
```

## 3.3 Check that the three tables match

```{r}
# Every ASV in the counts has a taxonomy, and vice versa
setequal(asv_clean$asv_id, tax_clean$asv_id)

# Every sample in the counts has metadata, and vice versa
setequal(asv_clean$sample_id, meta_clean$sample_id)
```

# 4. Write clean data

```{r}
write_tsv(x = meta_clean, file = "../data/02_dat_clean_meta.tsv")
write_tsv(x = tax_clean, file = "../data/02_dat_clean_tax.tsv")
write_tsv(x = asv_clean, file = "../data/02_dat_clean_asv.tsv")
```
